class: Any request path that awaits a vendor REST read (Kite /quote) before the tick store is judged turns every page poll into a vendor call; the per-key quota (1 quote/s, 10 s cooldown after a 429) is then spent by the polls, and a request that releases its own hold on the feed parks a quote another reader still needs.
mechanism: run_check (plan-watch, every 5 s), adjustment.py, playbooks.py awaited adjustment_readers.read_rest_spot -> live_market.index_spot before judge_spot consulted the tick store; _window_spot asked REST again when the index was not on the socket; there was no cache, so 12-24 index REST calls per minute per open builder produced 429s (kite_read_busy). Open legs were held on the socket only for one request (hold_and_read always releases), so each poll resubscribed and waited for a fresh tick (25-50 s on a quiet option).

first_seen.evidence: owner: one Kite socket up since 08:15; 56 'kite read HTTP status 429' + 'REST index quote failed: kite_read_busy' by 09:45 (~2/min); leg quotes stale every 25-50 s while NIFTY ticked on the strip; Exit greyed 'Prices are not live'.

fix: ONE index-spot door: routes.outcome.rest_spot_if_needed judges the tick store first (no REST call with a fresh tick); live_market.index_spot reads REST through one per-process SharedReading (TTL 5 s, single flight, a failure kept 10 s so nothing is sent inside the cooldown). PaperMonitor.reload holds every open paper leg and its index for as long as the strategy is open (fan-out is refcounted: a request's release no longer unsubscribes the vendor).

detection.note: Residual: the limiter and SharedReading are per process (API, worker, feed); the VIX read (30 s) shares the quote bucket. The 25-50 s leg-stale cause is code-derived, not measured: confirm with the duration log after deploy.
